name: John Bunyan
bio: John Bunyan (1628–1688) was an English Baptist preacher and writer, imprisoned for unlicensed preaching, and author of The Pilgrim’s Progress.
Songs and rhymes occur throughout his prose works and in A Book for Boys and Girls.

poems.title: The Shepherd Boy sings in the Valley of Humiliation
poems.author: John Bunyan
poems.text:
He that is down needs fear no fall,
  He that is low, no pride;
He that is humble ever shall
  Have God to be his guide.

I am content with what I have,
  Little be it or much:
And, Lord, contentment still I crave,
  Because Thou savest such.

Fullness to such a burden is
  That go on pilgrimage:
Here little, and hereafter bliss,
  Is best from age to age.
